occurrences.text: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.
In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
